items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: But Mr. Pierce was supposed to be my manager

ctx.x: Yeah. And they didn't know where you were, the O.K. people.

Uh-huh. Because see, they -- I wanted to -- I wanted (unintelligible). But Mr. Pierce was supposed to be my manager, I thought he would let me (unintelligible). See, I didn't know he didn't have music with the O.K. people. He must have held me because they -- he left them up there. Somebody must have helped him.
Well, didn't you care? Didn't you care that you weren't recording any more?
